# Falco eBPF Kernel Runtime Security & Threat Detection

Runtime threat detection in Kubernetes using Falco eBPF: detecting unexpected shells in pods, sensitive file access (/etc/shadow), and privilege escalation.

## Invariants
- ALERT_IMMEDIATELY_ON_SHELL_SPAWNED_IN_CONTAINER
- FORBID_MODIFICATIONS_TO_SYSTEM_BINARIES
- INTEGRATE_FALCO_EVENTS_WITH_SIEM
